goal: Balanced sync schedule (every 4 hours) + early-exit optimization to conserve Actions minutes

earlyExitOptimization.strategy: Run lightweight python check (.sync/refresh.py + test_refresh.py + build.py --check) first
earlyExitOptimization.gate: git diff --quiet catalog.json app.js on schedule events
earlyExitOptimization.behaviorOnNoChange: Skips Node setup, npm ci, Playwright Chromium install (~200MB), browser tests, git push, and Pages redeploy. Finishes in ~15 seconds with success checkmark.
earlyExitOptimization.behaviorOnChange: Executes full Node setup, npm ci, Playwright Chromium, npm test, commit via github-actions[bot], and deploys to GitHub Pages.
earlyExitOptimization.behaviorOnPushOrDispatch: Always runs full validation and deployment.

estimatedResourceSavings.timePerNoChangeRun: Reduced from ~90-120 seconds to ~15 seconds (~85% faster)
estimatedResourceSavings.monthlyActionsMinutes: Reduced from ~1,440 minutes/month to ~45-90 minutes/month (~95% savings)
